{
  "sql": "SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  md_sub.pref_name AS substrate_compound_name,
  md_par.pref_name AS parent_compound_name,
  m.met_conversion,

JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md_sub ON cr_sub.molregno = md_sub.molregno

ORDER BY
  cs.canonical_smiles ASC,
  md_sub.pref_name ASC,
  md_par.pref_name ASC,
  m.met_conversion ASC,
  m.pathway_key ASC,
  m.organism ASC,
  m.enzyme_name ASC
LIMIT 200;"
}
